ra1.candidate_definition: family B0.2 scan with exactly one axis replaced by the bank recipe on the same market view, dates, and episode accounting

negative_control.full_history_job_compare_reason: corrected B0.2 run root not supplied in this stage A run; orchestrating session supplies path and sha256 at resume

ra1.overrides: keyword-only mapping stage_name -> recipe implementation; omitted and None are byte-identical

Delta.note: delta input of confirmation; applied at stage evaluation on the enumerated contacts

Formation.note: formation part of context/reference; applied at enumeration, may change the contact population

Memory.note: contact-memory filter; applied at stage evaluation on the enumerated contacts

Profile.note: reference profile construction; applied at stage evaluation on the enumerated contacts

Reference.note: the reference object itself; applied at enumeration, may change the contact population

Sequence.note: the sequence machine; applied at stage evaluation on the enumerated contacts

Timing.note: trigger window and expiry; applied at enumeration, may change the contact population

amendment.ruling: Recipes on the Formation, Reference and Timing axes apply at enumeration time, before the adapter builds references and contacts, and may change the contact population. Recipes on the Profile, Delta, Sequence and Memory axes apply at stage evaluation on the contacts B0.2 has already enumerated. The earlier map applied every axis after enumeration, so Formation, Reference and Timing candidates could not change which contacts exist.

ra2_axis_to_stage.unsupported_policy: record with reason; stay in the frozen list; nothing silently dropped; no candidate added

ra5_throughput.cold_cost_note: The per-(family, branch) cold cost is real work and is paid once per family-branch per session by warm_session's branch prepay. It is not removed, only amortized: the first B0.2 scan of KEANI-OPEN-ABOVE-VALUE:source_long drives 360 historical_features.profile calls whose results memoize on the market object. The headline projection is therefore the per-session formula, which counts that cost once per session, not the contract formula, which would charge it to all 160 candidates.

columns.fresh: first scan of that (family, branch) on the session, after the data-plane warm only
columns.warm_repeat: second scan of the same candidate on the same session

ra5_throughput.engine: per-session data plane plus per-(family, branch) cold-scan prepay; whole bank evaluated on one loaded account-day view
ra5_throughput.projection_p90_source: max fresh (cold) per-candidate p90 over the seven RA-5 candidates

ra6_identities.corrected_b02_run_root_reason: the corrected full-history run is being produced on main concurrently; the orchestrating session supplies path and sha256 at resume
ra6_identities.p15_16a_receipt_reason: its receipt is being issued by the integration round on main concurrently

recipe_limitations: F2 completes the source formation's own volume within max_minutes; the bank's median_sessions parameter would need 20 prior sessions, which stage A does not load. Stage B loads them.
C3 scores the current delta bucket against earlier same-session buckets; the bank's history_sessions parameter would need 20 prior sessions. Stage B loads them.

P1/P2 rebuild the value reference from the raw tick tape of the account-day view up to the stage's own known_at (developing value). The prior completed session's raw tape is not in the account-day view; stage B loads it for families whose profile reference is the prior session.
